reason: I travel a lot and always leave pills at home, so a counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the first thing that actually fits how I live. The named lab and the report on the page answer my first question, and $24.99 for one box is an easy test.
objection: I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I worry I'll quit after a week. I'd also want to open the lab report and see the lab is real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch wasn't actually on the page or the QR code didn't work, I wouldn't buy.
